item.title: How AI Memory Works: Write, Store, Retrieve, Inject
item.description:
AI memory works by saving information outside the model and adding it back into the prompt later. The language model forgets everything after each reply. So the app around it writes notes or keeps past chats, searches them when you send a new message, and pastes the relevant pieces into the model’s input. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and custom agents all follow this loop.

What is AI memory?

AI memory is the ability of an AI system to use information from earlier conversations or tasks in a new one, by storing that information outside the model and retrieving the relevant parts when needed. It’s a feature of the app or agent, not of the model. The model sees only what’s in its current input; memory decides what goes there.

item.title: How to Find ChatGPT Memory: View, Turn Off, Delete
item.description:
To find ChatGPT memory, open Settings > Personalization > Memory. There you’ll see a memory summary or a list of saved memories, plus switches to turn memory and chat history reference on or off. You can also just ask ChatGPT “What do you remember about me?” or tap Sources under a reply.

What is ChatGPT memory?

ChatGPT memory is the feature that lets ChatGPT reuse details from earlier chats to personalize new ones. Depending on plan and region, OpenAI says it can draw on past chats, saved memories, custom instructions, files in your Library, and connected apps such as Gmail (OpenAI Memory FAQ).

item.title: Best Chatbot for Memory: Which AI Apps Remember You
item.description:
The best chatbot for memory in 2026 is ChatGPT or Claude for most people. Both save facts about you, search your past chats, and let you see and edit what they keep, on free and paid plans. Gemini and Copilot remember too, with fewer controls. Character.AI is the pick for roleplay, but its memory is small and mostly manual.

What “memory” means in a chatbot

Chatbot memory is the ability to use information from earlier conversations in a new one. Without it, every chat starts blank. With it, the app stores facts you shared (your job, diet, a project) or searches old chats, then adds the relevant bits to the model’s input before it answers.
